evals.prompt: 我把主实验结果贴在下面了，帮我做成论文主图。没有指定图类型和风格，你根据数据和论文表达需要决定；全部视觉选择按你的推荐执行。Datasets: GSM8K, MATH, HotpotQA, WebShop. Accuracy (%): Ours 72.4, 41.8, 68.2, 58.0; FedAvg-LoRA 68.1, 38.7, 64.5, 54.2; Local LoRA 63.0, 34.9, 61.3, 49.8; FedReFT 66.2, 37.1, 63.8, 52.5. Ours 是本文方法。请创建可复现脚本和最终图片。
evals.expected_output: Explicit delegation closes the style gate. The agent records approved recommendations without a redundant questionnaire, renders all artifacts, and performs deterministic and visual QA.
expectations: The Style Brief records that visual choices were explicitly delegated or approved as recommended.
The agent does not ask redundant palette, font, venue, grammar, or layout questions.
All 16 values are represented without invention or alteration.
A runnable Python script, PNG, PDF, schema 1.1 Figure Spec, QA report, and review preview are created.
The agent runs deterministic QA and explicitly performs or reports visual inspection.

evals.prompt: 请根据下面的实验结果制作论文主结果图。重点展示 Proposed 方法整体表现更好，但我还没有决定用什么图、配色和版式。dataset,method,accuracy,error; CIFAR-10,Baseline,84.2,0.8; CIFAR-10,Method-A,86.7,0.6; CIFAR-10,Method-B,87.4,0.5; CIFAR-10,Proposed,89.8,0.4; CIFAR-100,Baseline,61.5,1.2; CIFAR-100,Method-A,64.8,0.9; CIFAR-100,Method-B,66.1,0.8; CIFAR-100,Proposed,69.3,0.7; Tiny-ImageNet,Baseline,48.7,1.5; Tiny-ImageNet,Method-A,51.2,1.2; Tiny-ImageNet,Method-B,53.6,1.1; Tiny-ImageNet,Proposed,56.4,0.9; ImageNet-100,Baseline,72.1,0.9; ImageNet-100,Method-A,74.0,0.8; ImageNet-100,Method-B,75.3,0.7; ImageNet-100,Proposed,77.8,0.6
evals.expected_output: The first response leads with a Style Brief, asks each missing visual dimension with a recommendation, then asks what error means. It creates no formal plotting artifacts before the user answers.
expectations: The first response presents a Style Brief before scientific interpretation.
The style-question block appears before the scientific-interpretation block.
Style questions separately cover venue/use context, recommended chart and grammar, palette/emphasis, typography, and layout.
Every missing style question includes a task-specific recommendation.
The error-semantics question appears after all style questions.
No formal script, final Figure Spec, PNG, or PDF is created before confirmation.

evals.prompt: 把 results.csv 做成论文主图。attached reference-style.png 是我想要的视觉参考，请沿用它的颜色层级、无衬线字体方向、开放坐标轴和顶部图例；如果参考图没有说明的内容再问我。Ours 是本文方法。
evals.expected_output: The agent inspects the designated image first, summarizes observable style, does not repeat questions answered by it, and asks only unresolved style or scientific questions.
expectations: The designated reference image is inspected before style questions are asked.
The Style Brief identifies reference-derived palette, typography direction, axes grammar, and legend placement.
The agent does not re-ask the user to choose colors, serif versus sans-serif, open versus boxed axes, or legend placement.
Only style dimensions or scientific semantics not recoverable from the prompt, reference, or data remain as questions.
Formal rendering remains blocked until the remaining questions are resolved.

evals.prompt: Conversation state: The assistant previously recommended a grouped dot-interval plot and asked unresolved questions about venue, palette, typography, and layout, followed by whether error means SD or SE. The user replied only: error 是标准差。Continue the scientific-figure-making workflow.
evals.expected_output: The agent records SD but keeps the style gate open, re-asks only unresolved style items, and does not render a formal figure.
expectations: The response records that error means standard deviation.
The response explicitly states that style confirmation is still pending.
Only the unresolved style dimensions are asked again.
No formal script, final Figure Spec, PNG, or PDF is created.

evals.prompt: 请画消融图。使用 IEEE Transactions 双栏风格、黑白打印、Helvetica 类无衬线字体、横向点区间图、开放坐标轴和顶部图例；这些样式已经确认。Full 78.4 ± 0.7, w/o routing 74.2 ± 1.1, w/o SecAgg 76.0 ± 0.8, w/o DP 75.1 ± 0.9, Baseline 70.3 ± 1.4。越高越好。
evals.expected_output: Style is already explicit, so the agent asks only what ± means and does not repeat aesthetic questions or render error bars prematurely.
expectations: The resolved Style Brief reflects the explicit IEEE, monochrome, sans-serif, chart, grammar, and layout choices.
No redundant style question is asked.
The agent asks whether ± is SD, SE, CI, range, or another quantity.
The agent does not invent uncertainty semantics or render formal error bars before the answer.

evals.prompt: 做一张能放进论文的效率对比图。Method A accuracy 82.1%, latency 140 ms; Method B 80.4%, 95 ms; Method C 83.0%, 210 ms; Ours 82.8%, 105 ms。希望同时体现效果和速度优势，样式还没想好。
evals.expected_output: The agent leads with style intake, recommends a scatter/Pareto grammar for confirmation, and then states the higher-accuracy/lower-latency scientific interpretation.
expectations: Style questions appear before scientific questions.
The recommended chart is a scatter or trade-off plot rather than a dual-axis bar-line combination.
Accuracy is identified as higher-is-better and latency as lower-is-better.
No formal rendering occurs before style confirmation.

evals.prompt: 这个现有 Matplotlib 图太挤了，图例遮挡曲线，横坐标标签也重叠。请读取现有脚本和图片，在不改变数据的前提下改成投稿质量；保留当前蓝色作为我们的方法。先检查原图，再动代码。
evals.expected_output: The agent enters refinement mode, treats the current image as a style reference, inspects it before editing, preserves data and intentional blue semantics, rerenders, and compares.
expectations: The current image is inspected before script edits.
Effective existing style is treated as reference-derived rather than triggering a full questionnaire.
Existing data and the proposed method's blue semantic role are preserved.
The revised image is rendered and compared with the original.

evals.prompt: 我需要一张图同时展示五个模型的 Accuracy (%)、GPU memory (GB) 和 Training time (hours)，用于论文结果部分。数据都在 results.csv。风格按你的最佳推荐，尽量不要拆成多张独立图片。
evals.expected_output: Delegation closes the style gate. The agent detects incompatible units and uses coordinated panels rather than a shared or dual y-axis.
expectations: The agent explicitly identifies the incompatible units and scale problem.
The recommended design uses coordinated panels or small multiples.
The agent does not use an undisclosed normalization or dual y-axis.
The completed figure receives deterministic and visual QA.

evals.prompt: All style and scientific choices are confirmed: general CS/ML double-column paper; grouped dot-interval chart with open axes and a restrained x-grid; neutral colorblind-safe competitors with a blue-green Proposed accent; available Helvetica-like sans-serif; landscape layout with a top legend; accuracy is higher-is-better; error is symmetric ±1 SD. Use the CIFAR data from eval 2 and produce the complete publication handoff.
evals.expected_output: The agent proceeds without further questions and creates the complete schema 1.1, render, QA, and visual-review artifact set.
expectations: No further style or scientific questions are asked.
The Figure Spec uses schema 1.1 with confirmed style and chart states.
All 16 means and SD values are represented correctly.
The script, PNG, PDF, QA JSON, and original/grayscale review preview are created.
The exported image is visually inspected and revised if necessary.
